basic_details.job_title: AIIMS New Delhi (CDER) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Five project posts, one each of Project Research Scientist III (Medical), Project Research Scientist I (Medical) and Project Technical Support III, II and I, are open in the CDER, AIIMS-ICMR project "Project ORO-PAL" (Project Code: I-2048) at AIIMS New Delhi, with a tenure of 3 years and monthly pay from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 93,000 plus HRA. Essential qualifications run from 10th plus a diploma to BDS with MDS. Applications go through Google Forms by 25 November 2026, and the interview is on 30 November 2026.

qualification.details: Project Research Scientist III (Medical): knowledge of trials, implementation research, economic evaluation, management skills. Project Research Scientist I (Medical): MDS (Public Health Dentistry); experience in field research, biostatistics and scientific writing. Project Technical Support III: experience in field research, participant recruitment, qualitative data collection. Project Technical Support II: experience in clinical research data management and statistical analysis. | The notice prints no desirable qualification for Project Technical Support I. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: The notice asks interested candidates to apply through two Google Forms links. It does not describe further form-filling steps or name any documents to attach.
For Project Research Scientist III (Medical) and Project Research Scientist I (Medical), use the form at https://forms.gle/RSGHzVhZ3hgQrU6P6
For Project Technical Support III, II and I, use the form at https://forms.gle/FPvPx9nvyc1Y3SJV8
Apply on or before 25 November 2026, the last date of applying printed in the notice.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Project ORO-PAL: Integrating Oral Healthcare within Palliative Care at a Tertiary Level - A Hybrid Effectiveness-Implementation Study with Economic Evaluation
Project Research Scientist III (Medical), Project Research Scientist I (Medical), Project Technical Support III, Project Technical Support II, Project Technical Support I
Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 93,000 a month, with HRA (see Pay and Tenure)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 5 posts in all, one for each post name. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification, experience and the maximum age for each post are given below as printed in the notice. The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Project Research Scientist III (Medical): knowledge of trials, implementation research, economic evaluation, management skills. Project Research Scientist I (Medical): MDS (Public Health Dentistry); experience in field research, biostatistics and scientific writing. Project Technical Support III: experience in field research, participant recruitment, qualitative data collection. Project Technical Support II: experience in clinical research data management and statistical analysis. The notice prints no desirable qualification for Project Technical Support I. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: BDS + MDS in Public Health Dentistry
Three-year graduate degree in Social Work or another relevant health-related discipline OR Postgraduate degree in Social Work or another relevant health-related discipline
rows.experience: 3 years' post qualification experience OR Nil

rows.essential_qualification: 12th in Science + Diploma (Engineering/equivalent) OR 3 years graduate degree in relevant field (CS/IT/BCA)
rows.experience: 5 years' experience in relevant field OR 2 years' experience in relevant field

rows.essential_qualification: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) OR 3 years graduate degree in relevant field
rows.experience: Two years' experience in relevant field OR One year experience in relevant field

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Every post has a tenure of 3 years. HRA is printed at 30% for the two Project Research Scientist posts and as "HRA as admissible" for the three Project Technical Support posts. The notice gives the approximate date of appointment as 1 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested candidates to apply through two Google Forms links. It does not describe further form-filling steps or name any documents to attach. For Project Research Scientist III (Medical) and Project Research Scientist I (Medical), use the form at https://forms.gle/RSGHzVhZ3hgQrU6P6 For Project Technical Support III, II and I, use the form at https://forms.gle/FPvPx9nvyc1Y3SJV8 Apply on or before 25 November 2026, the last date of applying printed in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for an interview, which is on 30 November 2026. The time and venue will be communicated to candidates by email. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the AIIMS New Delhi project recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts, one each of Project Research Scientist III (Medical), Project Research Scientist I (Medical), Project Technical Support III, Project Technical Support II and Project Technical Support I.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of applying for the posts is 25 November 2026. The advertisement is dated 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist III (Medical)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is BDS + MDS in Public Health Dentistry, with 3 years post qualification experience. Knowledge of trials, implementation research, economic evaluation and management skills is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support I?
faq.answer: The qualification is 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) OR 3 years graduate degree in relevant field. Experience required is two years in the relevant field OR one year in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The limit varies by post: 45 years for Project Research Scientist III, 35 years for Project Research Scientist I and Project Technical Support III, 30 years for Project Technical Support II, and 28 years for Project Technical Support I.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Monthly emoluments are Rs. 93,000 (PRS-III), Rs. 67,000 (PRS-I), Rs. 28,000 (PTS-III), Rs. 20,000 (PTS-II) and Rs. 18,000 (PTS-I), each with HRA as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The two Project Research Scientist posts carry HRA@30%, and the three Project Technical Support posts carry "HRA as admissible", as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Use https://forms.gle/RSGHzVhZ3hgQrU6P6 for Project Research Scientist III and I, or https://forms.gle/FPvPx9nvyc1Y3SJV8 for Project Technical Support III, II and I.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates are called for an interview on 30 November 2026. The time and venue are communicated by email.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the appointment, and is TA/DA given for the interview?
faq.answer: Every post has a tenure of 3 years. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
